MIKE-INDEED-INTEGRATION-001.objective: Determine the official supported method for Party Perfect, as a DIRECT EMPLOYER, to automatically ingest Indeed applicants into the existing hiring database. Prefer Indeed Candidate Sync / Retrieve Candidates / Indeed Apply over browser automation. No stored Indeed password, no scraping authenticated pages, no submitting applications or contacting candidates.
MIKE-INDEED-INTEGRATION-001.expected_evidence: Official API path identified with eligibility/OAuth requirements, payload field map, resume handling, dedupe rules, and a normalization spec into Mike schema; implementation packet for Cursor

MIKE-INDEED-WEBHOOK-001.objective: Implement POST /api/jobs/indeed-apply. VERIFIED Indeed payload: top-level id (idempotency key), appliedOnMillis, job{jobId,jobKey,jobTitle}, applicant{fullName,email,phoneNumber,coverletter,resume{file{fileName,contentType,data},text,json{location{city}}}}, screenerQuestionsAndAnswers. HARD RULE: drop demographicQuestionsAndAnswers, applicant.dateOfBirth, applicant.gender, analytics.ip, analytics.userAgent at the intake boundary — never stored, never passed to Mike, never logged. Verify X-Indeed-Signature (HMAC-SHA1 over the RAW unaltered body) BEFORE parsing. Idempotent on top-level id. Reuse findRecentDuplicate. applyMode=enrich, referralSource=indeed. Resume base64 -> existing blob pipeline. Synthetic test applicants only.
MIKE-INDEED-WEBHOOK-001.expected_evidence: Bad signature rejected; valid accepted; replay of same id creates no duplicate; missing optional fields do not crash; demographic/EEO fields provably absent from stored record, Mike input and logs; resume stored via blob pipeline; enrich-mode application visible in Command Center.
MIKE-INDEED-WEBHOOK-001.known_limitations: Indeed field names must be taken from the live Application data reference, not from the spec table. Shared secret comes from env/secret store — never in a task record or git.

MIKE-INDEED-VERIFY-001.objective: Adversarially verify the Indeed webhook. Attack: forged/absent X-Indeed-Signature; signature computed over a re-serialized rather than raw body; replayed delivery creating a duplicate; malformed/partial payload crashing the route; resume bytes escaping the blob pipeline; PII or resume text leaking into logs, git, AI-HANDOFF or test fixtures. CRITICAL: prove demographicQuestionsAndAnswers, dateOfBirth and gender never reach the stored record, Mike scoring, or any log — feeding those into a hiring score would discriminate on protected characteristics. Also confirm an Indeed applicant is NOT recorded as a full application (would undermine D-001).
